name: Anass Fidni
abstract_title: From Molecules to Meaning: A Multilevel Model of Psychedelic Modulation of Phenomenal Consciousness
abstract: Psychedelic compounds produce profound alterations in perception, self-representation, emotion, and meaning-making. While traditionally attributed to 5-HT2A receptor activation, recent evidence indicates that their effects emerge from multi-target pharmacology and subsequent systems-level reorganization of brain activity.
